title: Seed autonomous work from a durable backlog
summary: Teach the continuation loop to seed the next bounded autonomous task from a curated backlog when every tracked task is already integrated or blocked.
expectedFailureModes: The autonomous loop stops whenever the task directory has no active candidate.
Backlog task templates drift from the workflow schema and create invalid task records.
Continuation silently creates duplicate task files or hides that it seeded work.
nextAction: Integrated locally; keep backlog templates small, bounded, and truthful whenever the roadmap changes.
